beats.care: Planning to get your licence soon? The test may get harder. Start prepping properly.
beats.what: Draft changes to the Central Motor Vehicles Rules would raise the learner's test pass mark from 60% to 75%.
beats.why: Applicants would also watch a 30-minute safe-driving tutorial and get 15 days instead of 7 to finish the process.

cards.body: A new Form 2A would combine renewals, duplicates and updates. Changing your name or address would be free. Blood group and emergency contact would be collected.
People with epilepsy who had a seizure in the last three years, or are on anti-epileptic medicine, would not be eligible.

cards.q: Is a tougher learner's test a good idea?
What would the new learner's test pass mark be?
cards.why: The draft raises it from 60% to 75%.

hook: Learner's licence test pass mark may jump from 60% to *75%*

learn.t: Draft rules are open for public feedback for 30 days before the government decides.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Driving licence rule amendments seek to raise bar for learner's test (print, Hyderabad edition, 24 Oct, p.12)

tldr: The Centre's draft rules would make the learner's test tougher, move many licence services online, and make some changes free.
watch: Feedback is open for 30 days. Watch for the final rules and when they take effect.
